comments.body:
UAT — /hivemind-beta:preview command + preview docs (all PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request; uat-only done-gate). Steps:
1) (AC1) commands/preview.md exists with correct structure — Expected: frontmatter description + heading + console-consistent invocation + deep-link. Observed: `---`/description present, heading `# /hivemind-beta:preview`, launches `node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/task-board.cjs --port 4517`, instructs opening http://127.0.0.1:4517/?tab=preview, notes both ?tab=preview and #preview. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
2) (AC1) deep-link focuses the Preview panel — Expected: ?tab=preview opens on the Preview tab. Observed: served HTML carries the IIFE (URLSearchParams -> params.get('tab') -> tabParam==='preview' -> activateTab('preview'); #preview also handled); tab-preview + panel-preview present; default (no param) still opens Orchestrator. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
3) (AC2) skill documents the feature — Expected: 4 fields, web vs process, precedence, lifecycle. Observed: orchestrator-routing SKILL.md has a preview section with a field table (preview_command/preview_url/preview_port/preview_mode), web-vs-process derivation, precedence (configured triggers on the 3 command/URL fields; preview_mode alone does NOT; inference dev>start>serve incl 0.0.0.0:N), and a lifecycle table with the CORRECTED status payload {state,mode,url,source,recentLogs} + SSE log/state/status events. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
4) (AC2) plugin-root parity copy byte-identical — Expected: the two SKILL.md byte-identical. Observed: cmp -s -> IDENTICAL; parity test tests/orchestrator-routing-skill.spec.js (6 tests incl byte-identity) green. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
5) (AC3) repo PROJECT.md documents the preview block — Expected: a block or documented how. Observed: PROJECT.md has a `## Preview` commented example (this repo is type:other with no dev server, so a documented example rather than a live block — least-surprising). PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
AC4 no new specs: confirmed (uat-only). Suite green: npm run test:all 922 passed/5 skipped. OVERALL: PASS — every AC covered, all steps PASS.
